repair.purpose: test D-arm model-discrepancy width against the corrected grouped posterior covariance

mode_level_diagnosis.interpretation: D width inflation moves across-seed mode coverage close to nominal, while the legacy per-voxel gate becomes less informative.

analytic_sigma_diagnosis.interpretation: Replacing 16-draw sample sigma with exact Laplace sigma removes Monte-Carlo width noise but reveals broad intervals remain; this is diagnostic only.

interpretation: A scalar per-arm width repair cannot make the legacy per-voxel metric pass: A/C remain over-covered and D becomes over-broad. The across-seed latent-mode metric is the scientifically relevant calibration diagnostic for this eight-mode posterior, but it is not yet a promotion gate.
next_action: Keep the mode-level coverage metric diagnostic-only; audit the analytic-sigma gate redesign proposal, then add a mark-side misspecification arm. Do not open validation or B2.
